title: Integral rational representation group and associated-bundle action
statement: Let $F$ be a field [def-weil-field] and $G$ an affine $F$-group scheme [def-sc-group-scheme], with its canonical coordinate Hopf algebra $C=F[G]$ [def-sfb-affine-coordinate-hopf-algebra]. A finite-dimensional rational module is a finite-dimensional $F$-vector space $V$ with an $F$-linear map $\rho:V\to V\otimes_F C$ satisfying the counit and coassociativity identities of [def-sfb-hopf-action-module-data]. Its maps are linear maps commuting with coactions. Define its integral Grothendieck group as the free abelian group on these objects modulo isomorphism and short-exact-sequence relations, with exactness on the underlying vector spaces. Tensor multiplication is characterized by $(v\otimes w)\mapsto\sum_{i,j}(v_i\otimes w_j)\otimes c_i d_j$ when $\rho(v)=\sum_i v_i\otimes c_i$ and $\rho(w)=\sum_j w_j\otimes d_j$; the unit is $F$ with $x\mapsto x\otimes1$. A representation-ring structure is a commutative ring structure on this quotient with the existing additive group, normalized by these tensor and unit representatives and requiring that such representatives exist. If $G$ acts on an $F$-scheme $Y$, use the coherent equivariant Grothendieck group and tensor operation of [def-sfb-equivariant-coherent-gzero]. The associated bundle of $V$ is the actual pullback to $Y$ of $\widetilde V$ on $\operatorname{Spec}F$, with linearization $\beta:a^*E\simeq p^*E$ characterized on constant sections by $\beta^{-1}(p^*v)=\sum_i c_i\,a^*v_i$ whenever $\rho(v)=\sum_i v_i\otimes c_i$, where the coefficients are pulled back from $G$. An action of the representation ring on $G_0^G(Y)$ is an actual module structure normalized by $[V][M]=[E_V\otimes M]$, requiring existence of associated bundles and coherent tensor representatives. All underlying pullbacks are the recorded tensor-formula module pullbacks [def-pc-module-pullback].
